query: Kemon kichu student grade apeal korar pora? Amra janiy na ki amader course-er grade mistake holo kisu kichu.
reference_answer: A student may apply to the Chair of Department or the Dean for the re-checking of an examination script. Such a request may be made on the grounds of evidence of procedural errors, arbitrariness or prejudice. The student must make any request within Seven (07) calendar days of the publication of the mark. The Chair of Department or the Dean may, after checking with the original grader, arrange for the evaluation of an examination script to be conducted by two members of the faculty not previously involved in the examination and marking process, supported by a member of the Examination Controller’s office. The rechecking process and submission of any revised grade to the Examinations Controller should be completed within 15 calendar days.
source_english_question: Are students allowed to appeal their grades if they believe there has been a mistake?

query: Ami BRAC scholarship e amader international student, cgpa 3.1, kintu ami ekta course fail korlam, apnai scholarship er madhye retake fee cover hobe ki na?
reference_answer: No - tuition fee waivers and scholarships, including the BRAC Scholarship, are not applied to retake or repeat courses; you'd need to pay for the retake yourself. Separately, since you failed a course, you also won't be considered for the tuition fee waiver for the following two semesters even on your other coursework, regardless of your CGPA being above the 3.0 minimum.
source_english_question: I'm an international student on the BRAC Scholarship with a 3.1 CGPA, but I need to retake a course I failed. Will my scholarship cover the retake fee?

query: Amarader kichu detail dekhabe ki BRAC Uni te tuition fee structure ta kemon?
reference_answer: For students enrolled in the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) program at BRAC University, the tuition fee structure includes a one-time, non-refundable admission fee of BDT 30,800. Each course within the CSE program costs BDT 22,500. Additionally, students are required to pay a semester fee of BDT 11,500, which covers various facilities such as IT services and library access. There is also a one-time library membership fee of BDT 2,500. This fee structure is designed to support the comprehensive education provided in the CSE program, ensuring access to advanced resources and facilities?
source_english_question: Could you please provide details about the tuition fee structure at BRAC University?

query: Ami EEE er student amar physics e minor korte chai. Ami physics majore nai, tai physics minor er prerequisite separate meet korbo ki na?
reference_answer: Yes - BRACU's Minor in Physics has its own defined set of required courses and prerequisites, separate from your EEE major requirements, open to students from other departments as long as they meet those specific prerequisites. Being an EEE major doesn't automatically satisfy the Physics minor's course requirements; you'd need to check and fulfill them independently.
source_english_question: I'm an EEE student minoring in Physics. Do I need to separately meet the Physics minor's prerequisites even though I'm not a Physics major?
